import sys, json, urllib.request

data = json.load(sys.stdin)
videos = data if isinstance(data, list) else data.get('videos', data.get('data', []))

print(f'Checking {len(videos)} video files for duplicates...')
print()

etags = {}
for v in videos:
    vid_id = v.get('id', v.get('video_id', 'N/A'))
    title = v.get('title', 'N/A')
    video_url = v.get('video_url', '')
    poster_url = v.get('poster_url', '')

    if not video_url:
        print(f'  {vid_id}: NO video_url')
        continue

    # HEAD request for video
    req = urllib.request.Request(video_url, method='HEAD')
    try:
        resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10)
        etag = resp.headers.get('ETag', 'N/A')
        size = resp.headers.get('Content-Length', 'N/A')
        ctype = resp.headers.get('Content-Type', 'N/A')
        status = resp.status
    except Exception as e:
        etag = f'ERROR: {e}'
        size = 'N/A'
        ctype = 'N/A'
        status = 'ERR'

    # HEAD request for poster
    poster_status = 'N/A'
    poster_ctype = 'N/A'
    if poster_url:
        req2 = urllib.request.Request(poster_url, method='HEAD')
        try:
            resp2 = urllib.request.urlopen(req2, timeout=10)
            poster_status = resp2.status
            poster_ctype = resp2.headers.get('Content-Type', 'N/A')
        except Exception as e:
            poster_status = f'ERR: {e}'

    print(f'  {vid_id}: \"{title}\"')
    print(f'    video: HTTP {status} | ETag={etag} | size={size} | type={ctype}')
    print(f'    poster: HTTP {poster_status} | type={poster_ctype}')

    if etag != 'N/A' and etag != 'ERROR':
        if etag not in etags:
            etags[etag] = []
        etags[etag].append({'id': vid_id, 'title': title, 'size': size})

print()
print('=== DUPLICATE ANALYSIS ===')
dupes_found = False
for etag, records in etags.items():
    if len(records) > 1:
        dupes_found = True
        print(f'DUPLICATE ETag {etag} ({len(records)} records):')
        for r in records:
            print(f'  - {r[\"id\"]}: \"{r[\"title\"]}\" ({r[\"size\"]} bytes)')

if not dupes_found:
    print('NO DUPLICATES — all video files are unique')
else:
    unique = sum(1 for r in etags.values() if len(r) == 1)
    dup_groups = sum(1 for r in etags.values() if len(r) > 1)
    total_records = len(videos)
    unique_files = len(etags)
    print(f'Summary: {total_records} records, {unique_files} unique files, {dup_groups} duplicate groups')
"
